uplink.description: Status report with shock/tamper alarm (motion detected), three CT entries
uplink._note: Wire shape from the upstream R900NAC3 status-report example (bytes[15]=0x01 shock/tamper alarm); expected.data authored here and produced by running reference/upstream-codec.js to confirm the field layout (Volt 11, Current1..3 11mA, LowCurrent1Alarm 1, ShockTamperAlarm Alarm). Each CT input's reading and its own low/high alarm pair sit in that input's channels entry; shock maps to the whole-device action.motion.detected=true.

uplink.description: Status report with no alarm and low battery (motion not detected); 0 mA is a real reading, not a sentinel
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame: bytes[4]=0xA5 sets the low-battery high bit (0x25=37 -> 3.7 V), bytes[15]=0x00 NoAlarm -> action.motion.detected=false. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (Volt '3.7(low battery)', Current1 300mA, Current2/3 0mA, ShockTamperAlarm NoAlarm). The wire format has no disconnected-CT code, so the 0 mA inputs still get entries.

uplink.description: Status report with a distinct current and alarm pattern per CT (multi-CT)
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame giving each CT input a clearly distinct reading and alarm pair, so a per-position mix-up cannot pass: bytes[4]=0x24 -> 3.6 V, currents 300 / 10000 / 65535 mA, bytes[14]=26 (0b011010) -> HighCurrent1Alarm, HighCurrent2Alarm, LowCurrent3Alarm, bytes[15]=0x00 NoAlarm. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js field-for-field.

uplink.description: Device info / startup frame carries no measurement
uplink._note: Device-info frame: bytes[3]=0x00 -> Device/SWver/HWver/Datecode per reference/upstream-codec.js, no measurement. Zero-padded to 16 bytes so it reaches the reportType==0x00 branch (the short 10-byte upstream startup example would trip the length guard first).

uplink.description: Config response on fPort 23 carries no measurement
uplink._note: Upstream ConfigReportRsp example input on fPort 23. Config responses carry no measurement, so our codec rejects the fPort.
